name: Tilted Rows
description: A header over three rows of cards on a tilted plane that straightens as you scroll while the rows slide apart.

props.name: items
props.type: { title: string; src: string; href?: string }[]
props.description: Fifteen cards, five to a row. A card with href is a link; the title shows on a chip when the card is hovered or focused.

props.name: header
props.description: Headline and supporting line shown over the top of the plane. Bring your own heading element.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the outer section. It clips the rows that slide past its edges.
